doc: low = 5.0 on size 16: the modes (3, 4), (4, 3), (5, 0) and their signs have radius exactly 5.0 (hypot of integers is exact), and `kk >= low` keeps them: the cut is inclusive. The white noise the seed draws is the input plan0.white (size, size). FFT convention: numpy fft2 unnormalized forward, ifft2 divides by size^2, k = fftfreq(size) * size. Measured: every random input nudged by one float64 ulp (8 trials) and numpy.fft replaced by scipy.fft: max |diff| 1.8e-15 (6e-13 relative on values above 1e-3), so 1e-9 relative / 1e-10 absolute.
